title = #{title}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, target_type = #{targetType}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, is_active = #{isActive},

UPDATE TB_BANNER t JOIN ( SELECT b.seq, (@rownum := @rownum + 1) * 10 AS new_order FROM TB_BANNER b CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rownum := 0) AS dummy ORDER BY b.display_order ASC, b.reg_dt DESC ) r ON t.seq = r.seq SET t.display_order = r.new_order
